commands.description: Use Staryl’s Twitch subscription commands to send live and offline stream notifications to the right channel.
commands.title: Configure Twitch notifications with Staryl.

cta.subtitle: Invite Staryl now, or join the support server if you want to ask a question first.

features.description: A live alert with the stream's title, game and preview, an offline note in your own words, and a test whenever you want to check the channel.
features.live_body: The stream's title links to the channel, next to the game and its box art, above a preview of the stream and a button to watch.
features.notifications_description: Each subscription sends one streamer's live or offline update to one channel. Pick a kind to see what lands there.
features.offline_body: An offline subscription posts the message you wrote for it, with the time the stream ended. Offline subscriptions need that message.
features.offline_message: Stella's stream is over, thanks for watching!
features.ping_body: Give the subscription a message and it goes above the notification. Mention a role in it and Staryl pings that role, as long as the role can be mentioned.
features.test_body: A test goes through the same path as a real notification, so a missing permission shows up now and not at the next stream. It says it is a test.
features.test_notice: this is a preview requested by a server administrator, not a real stream update.
features.title: One message per stream, in your channel.
